notes: Eight own pages read, all HTTP 200 and not thin; the eight-page limit is reached. The home and about pages carry customer, partner and application counters whose numbers are not in the page text, so the two customer count claims are unverifiable. The trademarks page lists CreditAPI, LendingQB and LoansPQ as MeridianLink marks; it settles the CreditAPI name (C07) but not the LoansPQ and LendingQB renames (C02, C04), which no page read states or dates. Not coded: name mentions of OpenClose as a stand-alone alternative (q4 Claude 2 and 3), capability lists, implementation times, review ratings, and lines labelled as cost proxies or estimated cost (q1 Google AI Overviews 3, q2 Google AI Overviews 1 and 3, including a $1,500 to $5,000+ per month proxy range); the hedged $175 claims (C15) were coded because they are stated as the starting price. No claim is wrong or stale, so no cited page was read for causes. Pass 2 (8 Oct 2026): no browser snapshots exist for MeridianLink and no claim was unverifiable because a page was blocked or thin; a re-read of the about and home snapshots confirms the counters carry labels only (Customers, partners, years of service) with no numbers, so C18 and C19 stay unverifiable. The about page states 'Founded in 1998', but no answer makes a founding claim. The 29 gap lines are capability, decisioning, implementation and fit descriptions, unnamed bureau or core integrations, recommendations, and lines about other vendors (Abrigo formerly Sageworks, OpenClose, nCino on Salesforce); nothing added. The table and sub-heading scan of the full answers (q1, q2, q4 to q7 tables, the Google pipe tables, the MeridianLink pros and cons sections) found only lines already coded in answers that already carry the claim (the $175 table cells for C15, 'Proprietary cloud' and 'Built on' cells for C12) or out of scope (Salesforce dependency 'No' as a comparison, ratings, implementation times, cost opinions); nothing added. No wrong or stale claim to check.
